name: hackerspace-tycoon
description: Build a hackerspace, herd volunteers, ship physical projects (Three.js + TypeScript + Vite + Zustand)

scripts.sim-check: vite build --config vite.headless.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-headless/sim-check.js
scripts.time-budget: vite build --config vite.headless.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-headless/time-budget.js
scripts.project-times: vite build --config vite.headless.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-headless/project-times.js
scripts.era-pace: vite build --config vite.headless.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-headless/era-pace.js
scripts.hype-check: vite build --config vite.headless.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-headless/hype-check.js
scripts.kickoff-check: vite build --config vite.headless.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-headless/kickoff-check.js
scripts.layout-check: vite build --config vite.headless.config.ts --logLevel error && node dist-headless/layout-check.js
scripts.itch: tsc --noEmit && vite build --base=./ --sourcemap=false --outDir=dist-itch --emptyOutDir && mkdir -p release && rm -f release/hackerspace-tycoon-web-v$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist-itch && zip -qr ../release/hackerspace-tycoon-web-v$npm_package_version.zip . && cd .. && ls -la release/hackerspace-tycoon-web-v$npm_package_version.zip
